sections.title: Habit and habitat
sections.text: Dianthus gratianopolitanus, cheddar pink, is a mat-forming perennial native to Europe, often found in rock gardens and on calcareous soils. Its leafy cushion is about 15 cm tall and 10–50 cm wide.

sections.title: Flowers and plate
sections.text: Its fragrant pink flowers have finely toothed petals and are about 2 cm across. The plate matches the compact habit, fringed petals and capsule. The RHS notes a risk of skin allergy; no food use is stated here.
